title: 12 Best Tour the eerie 18th-century underground vaults hidden beneath Edinburgh's Royal Mile on a guided walk.
description: Uncover Edinburgh's darkest secrets on a guided walk through eerie 18th-century underground vaults beneath the Royal Mile. Explore hidden passages, hear ghost stories, and dive into history. Find the top tours!

places.name: Mercat Tours - Ghost and Ghouls Tour
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Listen for the chilling tale of the 'vault's resident' and keep an eye out for mysterious cold spots.

places.name: City of the Dead Tours - Underground City of the Dead Tour
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Prepare for potential paranormal activity; some tours use equipment or encourage interaction with the unknown.

places.name: The Real Mary King's Close Experience
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pay close attention to the stories of the residents – particularly the 'Annie' doll.

places.name: Auld Reekie Tours - Vaults of Terror Tour
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Listen for the chilling stories of Burke and Hare, and other notorious figures associated with the vaults.

places.name: Mercat Tours - Hidden and Haunted Tour
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The comprehensive historical preamble above ground perfectly sets the stage for the vault experience.

places.name: City of the Dead Tours - Haunted Graveyard & Underground Vaults Tour
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pay attention during the Greyfriars section for reported phenomena before entering the vaults.

places.name: Edinburgh Ghostly Underground Tour (by Old Town Tours)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Appreciate the personal touch and direct storytelling from the guide in the atmospheric chambers.

places.name: Black Hart Entertainment - Edinburgh Vaults Tour
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Engage with the guide and ask questions; they often have fascinating insights beyond the script.

places.name: Auld Reekie Tours - Blair Street Underground Vaults
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Focus on the unique architectural features and the stark contrast with the city above.

places.name: Invisible Cities Edinburgh - Vaults & Victorian Lives
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Appreciate the unique perspective and the social impact of your ticket purchase.

places.name: Royal Mile Underground Experiences - Vaults & Legends Tour
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Engage with the guide's storytelling and let your imagination roam.

places.name: Fright Nights Edinburgh - Ghost Hunt in the Vaults
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Actively participate in the ghost hunt, using the provided equipment and sharing your experiences.
